name: Distal Radius Fracture
definition: Fracture of the distal radius, commonly after a fall on an outstretched hand and frequently associated with osteoporosis in older adults.

investigations.principle: Radiographs characterize displacement, comminution and articular involvement.
investigations.MRI: CT can assist complex intra-articular planning; MRI is not routine.

amber: Operative fixation depends on alignment, stability, articular involvement, age and functional demand.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna principles may support rehabilitation only after reduction/stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the distal radius, commonly after a fall on an outstretched hand and frequently associated with osteoporosis in older adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
